description: River Urban Waste Water Pressures is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Protection Agency. Significant pressures have been identified for waterbodies that are At Risk of not meeting their water quality objectives under the Water Framework Directive. While there are a multitude of pressures in every waterbody, the significant pressures are those pressures which need to be addressed in order to improve water quality. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Protection Agency. Its tags are agglomeration, catchment, certificate of authorisation, characterisation, combined sewer overflows. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
